name: Forty-Fives
summary: Irish trick-taking card game descended from Spoil Five, played for 120 points with bidding for trump.
rules_text: Played with 52 cards. 4 to 6 players get 5 cards each. Players bid in turn, each bid being 15, 20, 25 or 30, representing points they will try to win. Highest bidder becomes declarer and names trump. Card rank in trump: 5 is highest, then Jack, Ace of Hearts, Ace of trump, then King, Queen etc; in other suits Ace of Hearts is still counted as trump. Non-trump suits rank King high. Players must follow suit if able. Highest trump wins trick, otherwise highest of led suit. Each trick is worth 5 points. If declarer makes at least bid, declarer scores what was made; otherwise loses the bid amount. Others score 5 per trick. First to 120 wins.
rating_reason: Auction trick-taking descendant of Spoil Five
